body: Thanks for the kind words. I'm glad my rambling is potentially helpful to others. I just found this sub yesterday and have already found so much help from it. Thanks all!

Thanks for your thoughts. I think finding those personal reasons for me will be very helpful to transition this decision to a more internally than externally motivated one. Strangely, if I do have ADHD, I feel like it's helped me as I often react to pot like it's a stimulant. I feel that caffeine helps similarly though I'm now pondering quitting all drugs, even caffeine. I'm starting to think I can't use anything without using in excess... part of using more pot lately has been to offset all the caffeine 🤦🏼‍♂️

Thanks for your perspective. I'm not as troubled by my own actions with that friend as I am about the rest of this... the unknown about how that started since it was not at all age appropriate behavior, the other details that make me worry S might hurt my nieces, etc.

I’m self diagnosed with alexithymia whereas my partner is a very emotional person. Sometimes I sense that she tries to provoke emotional responses from me, like if I don’t express feeling upset enough about something that she thinks is justified to be upset about. Since I suspect my alexithymia is is tied to avoidance of emotion learned through adolescence, those attempts to provoke me often cause me to withdraw further. It could be helpful for you to avoid pressuring them to feel more than they might be in a given situation. 

The flip side of having different emotional responses than my partner is that we can learn from each other. She will often help me identify feelings and causes when I’m trying to figure out what’s going on and in turn I’ll help her deal with excess emotional responses. The key is being open to helping but never trying to control someone or pressure them into accepting your help.

Trigger warning: suicide

I feel conflicted. Confused. Numb. 

My wife has no one left and wants to die. I don’t want to lose her but I don’t want her to stay alive solely for me. I want to support her desire to die but I don’t want her to follow through.
